title: Now fix something on your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have force-quit a frozen app, reconnected WiFi, read an error code and reinstalled a broken app in practice.
• Next time something freezes, do not hold the power button first. Try force-quitting just that app.
• When a page will not load, check whether other sites work. That tells you whether the problem is your connection or that one site.
• Write down an error code exactly as it appears before you close the message. Searching for it usually finds someone who has already solved it.
• Restarting genuinely fixes a surprising number of problems, and it costs you two minutes.
drDigitalSuccess: Most computer problems have a plain explanation and a two-minute fix.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then keep these four steps in mind next time something goes wrong.
